verification_note: This run reached a real breakthrough: the mcp__Firecrawl__firecrawl_scrape tool successfully fetched campusjobs.mlp.com, mlp.eightfold.ai, career.mlp.com-adjacent, www.ares.com and aresmgmt.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com directly (with maxAge:0 to force live fetches), even though our own environment's WebFetch/curl remain EGRESS_BLOCKED to every one of these domains as in every prior run. This is the first run able to get a direct, non-WebSearch-summary read on liveness for Millennium and Ares postings. Findings: (1) the live campusjobs.mlp.com listing currently shows 56 open jobs (down from 59 at the 2026-09-01 baseline), all 2027 internships across many locations/functions -- zero 'Analyst Program' or full-time Analyst-titled role of any kind is present; (2) both known Millennium Eightfold job IDs for 'Equities Analyst Program' (New York 755942100027, London 755942588377) return HTTP 404 with 'The job you are looking for may have closed.' when fetched directly -- both confirmed closed, including a brand-new NY job ID surfaced by this run's WebSearch that was closed on arrival; (3) a third URL for the same NY program on Millennium's Workday mirror (REQ-24769-1) returned HTTP 200 but only a client-rendered 'Loading' shell -- genuinely unconfirmed, logged as a candidate, not emailed; (4) www.ares.com/us/careers/early-careers, fetched directly, confirms in its own current text that the 2027 Summer Internship Program targets students graduating Dec 2027-Aug 2028 -- one full cycle later than Arnav's window -- and mentions no full-time Analyst Program; a spot-check of the first page of Ares' 270-job Workday listing (not exhaustive) showed only experienced-hire titles, no Analyst Program or 2027-grad language. No posting meeting BOTH the entry-level equity-research/investment-analyst archetype AND a directly-verified-live status for the Dec 2026-2027 grad window was found at either firm this run. No email was sent.
